name: Workorder Conformation Message
script:
# ============================================================
# JOB CARD WHATSAPP WORKFLOW
# ============================================================
# Server Script:
# Type: Document Event
# Doctype: WhatsApp Message
# Event: After Insert
#
# Buttons:
#   job_completed
#   job_pause
#   job_resume
#
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# ONLY PROCESS INCOMING BUTTON MESSAGES
# ============================================================

if doc.type == "Incoming" and doc.content_type == "button":

    action = str(doc.message or "").strip().lower()

    if action in ["job_completed", "job_pause", "job_resume"]:

        # ====================================================
        # PREVENT SAME BUTTON MESSAGE FROM BEING PROCESSED
        # TWICE
        # ====================================================

        previous = frappe.get_all(
            "WhatsApp Message",
            filters=[
                ["name", "!=", doc.name],
                ["type", "=", "Incoming"],
                [
                    "reply_to_message_id",
                    "=",
                    doc.reply_to_message_id
                ]
            ],
            fields=["name"],
            limit=1
        )

        if not previous:

            try:

                # =================================================
                # FIND ORIGINAL OUTGOING WHATSAPP MESSAGE
                # =================================================

                original = frappe.db.get_value(
                    "WhatsApp Message",
                    {
                        "message_id": doc.reply_to_message_id,
                        "type": "Outgoing"
                    },
                    [
                        "name",
                        "reference_doctype",
                        "reference_name"
                    ],
                    as_dict=True
                )

                if original and original.reference_doctype == "Job Card":

                    job_card_name = original.reference_name

                    # =============================================
                    # LOAD JOB CARD
                    # =============================================

                    job_card = frappe.get_doc(
                        "Job Card",
                        job_card_name
                    )

                    # =============================================
                    # ONLY UNSUBMITTED JOB CARDS
                    # =============================================

                    if job_card.docstatus == 0:

                        current_time = frappe.utils.now()

                        current_datetime = (
                            frappe.utils.get_datetime(
                                current_time
                            )
                        )

                        target_qty = (
                            job_card.get("for_quantity") or 0
                        )

                        expected_end = (
                            job_card.get("expected_end_date")
                        )

                        if expected_end:

                            formatted_end = (
                                frappe.utils.format_datetime(
                                    expected_end,
                                    "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss"
                                )
                            )

                        else:

                            formatted_end = "Not Set"

                        employee_phone = doc.get("from")


                        # =================================================
                        # =================================================
                        # PAUSE
                        # =================================================
                        # =================================================

                        if action == "job_pause":

                            if job_card.status == "Work In Progress":

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # SAME LOGIC AS YOUR WORKING manage_job_card
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                updated = False

                                for row in job_card.time_logs:

                                    if row.from_time and not row.to_time:

                                        row.to_time = current_time

                                        updated = True

                                        break

                                if updated:

                                    # -------------------------------------
                                    # SAVE TIME LOG
                                    # -------------------------------------

                                    job_card.save(
                                        ignore_permissions=True
                                    )

                                    # -------------------------------------
                                    # FORCE STATUS = ON HOLD
                                    # -------------------------------------

                                    frappe.db.set_value(
                                        "Job Card",
                                        job_card_name,
                                        "status",
                                        "On Hold",
                                        update_modified=True
                                    )

                                    # -------------------------------------
                                    # SET PAUSED FLAG
                                    # -------------------------------------

                                    frappe.db.set_value(
                                        "Job Card",
                                        job_card_name,
                                        "is_paused",
                                        1,
                                        update_modified=True
                                    )

                                    # -------------------------------------
                                    # WORKSTATION IDLE
                                    # -------------------------------------

                                    if job_card.workstation:

                                        frappe.db.set_value(
                                            "Workstation",
                                            job_card.workstation,
                                            "status",
                                            "Idle",
                                            update_modified=True
                                        )

                                    # -------------------------------------
                                    # SEND RESUME BUTTON
                                    # -------------------------------------

                                    pause_message = (
                                        "The Job has been paused.\n\n"
                                        "Job Card: "
                                        + str(job_card_name)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Target Quantity: "
                                        + str(target_qty)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Production End Time: "
                                        + str(formatted_end)
                                        + "\n\n"
                                        "Click Resume to continue the Job."
                                    )

                                    outgoing = frappe.get_doc({

                                        "doctype":
                                            "WhatsApp Message",

                                        "type":
                                            "Outgoing",

                                        "account":
                                            "My Whatsapp",

                                        "to":
                                            employee_phone,

                                        "content_type":
                                            "interactive",

                                        "message":
                                            pause_message,

                                        "buttons":
                                            json.dumps([
                                                {
                                                    "type": "button",
                                                    "title": "Resume",
                                                    "id": "job_resume"
                                                }
                                            ]),

                                        "reference_doctype":
                                            "Job Card",

                                        "reference_name":
                                            job_card_name
                                    })

                                    outgoing.insert(
                                        ignore_permissions=True
                                    )

                                else:

                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "Job Card: "
                                        + str(job_card_name)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "No active time log found.",
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP ERROR"
                                    )

                            else:

                                frappe.log_error(
                                    "Job Card: "
                                    + str(job_card_name)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "Current Status: "
                                    + str(job_card.status)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "Pause ignored.",
                                    "JOB CARD WHATSAPP ERROR"
                                )


                        # =================================================
                        # =================================================
                        # RESUME
                        # =================================================
                        # =================================================

                        elif action == "job_resume":

                            if job_card.status == "On Hold":

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # SAME LOGIC AS YOUR WORKING manage_job_card
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                job_card.append(
                                    "time_logs",
                                    {
                                        "from_time": current_time,
                                        "completed_qty": 0
                                    }
                                )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # SAVE NEW TIME LOG
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                job_card.save(
                                    ignore_permissions=True
                                )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # FORCE STATUS = WORK IN PROGRESS
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                frappe.db.set_value(
                                    "Job Card",
                                    job_card_name,
                                    "status",
                                    "Work In Progress",
                                    update_modified=True
                                )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # REMOVE PAUSED FLAG
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                frappe.db.set_value(
                                    "Job Card",
                                    job_card_name,
                                    "is_paused",
                                    0,
                                    update_modified=True
                                )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # CLEAR ACTUAL END
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                frappe.db.set_value(
                                    "Job Card",
                                    job_card_name,
                                    "actual_end_date",
                                    None,
                                    update_modified=True
                                )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # WORKSTATION PRODUCTION
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                if job_card.workstation:

                                    frappe.db.set_value(
                                        "Workstation",
                                        job_card.workstation,
                                        "status",
                                        "Production",
                                        update_modified=True
                                    )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # SEND COMPLETED + PAUSE
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                resume_message = (
                                    "The Job has been resumed.\n\n"
                                    "Job Card: "
                                    + str(job_card_name)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "Target Quantity: "
                                    + str(target_qty)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "Production End Time: "
                                    + str(formatted_end)
                                    + "\n\n"
                                    "Please select the current Job status."
                                )

                                outgoing = frappe.get_doc({

                                    "doctype":
                                        "WhatsApp Message",

                                    "type":
                                        "Outgoing",

                                    "account":
                                        "My Whatsapp",

                                    "to":
                                        employee_phone,

                                    "content_type":
                                        "interactive",

                                    "message":
                                        resume_message,

                                    "buttons":
                                        json.dumps([
                                            {
                                                "type": "button",
                                                "title": "Completed",
                                                "id": "job_completed"
                                            },
                                            {
                                                "type": "button",
                                                "title": "Pause",
                                                "id": "job_pause"
                                            }
                                        ]),

                                    "reference_doctype":
                                        "Job Card",

                                    "reference_name":
                                        job_card_name
                                })

                                outgoing.insert(
                                    ignore_permissions=True
                                )

                            else:

                                frappe.log_error(
                                    "Job Card: "
                                    + str(job_card_name)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "Current Status: "
                                    + str(job_card.status)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "Resume ignored.",
                                    "JOB CARD WHATSAPP ERROR"
                                )


                        # =================================================
                        # =================================================
                        # COMPLETED
                        # =================================================
                        # =================================================

                        elif action == "job_completed":

                            frappe.log_error(
                                "STEP 08 - COMPLETED ACTION STARTED\n"
                                "Job Card: " + str(job_card_name) + "\n"
                                "To: " + str(employee_phone),
                                "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                            )
                            completed_message = ""
                            current_time = frappe.utils.now()
                            current_datetime = frappe.utils.get_datetime(current_time)
                            try:

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # CURRENT TIME
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                current_time = frappe.utils.now()

                                current_datetime = (
                                    frappe.utils.get_datetime(
                                        current_time
                                    )
                                )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # TARGET QUANTITY
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                target_qty = (
                                    job_card.get("for_quantity") or 0
                                )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # EXPECTED END TIME
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                expected_end = (
                                    job_card.get("expected_end_date")
                                )

                                expected_end_datetime = None

                                if expected_end:

                                    expected_end_datetime = (
                                        frappe.utils.get_datetime(
                                            expected_end
                                        )
                                    )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # FORMAT END TIME FOR WHATSAPP
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                if expected_end_datetime:

                                    formatted_end = (
                                        frappe.utils.format_datetime(
                                            expected_end_datetime,
                                            "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss"
                                        )
                                    )

                                else:

                                    formatted_end = "Not Set"
                                    
                                frappe.log_error(
                                    "STEP 08A - Job Card data loaded\n"
                                    "Target Qty: " + str(target_qty) + "\n"
                                    "Expected End: " + str(formatted_end) + "\n"
                                    "Current Time: " + str(current_datetime),
                                    "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                    )

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # CHECK PRODUCTION END TIME
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                if (
                                    expected_end_datetime
                                    and current_datetime < expected_end_datetime
                                ):

                                    remaining_seconds = (
                                        expected_end_datetime
                                        - current_datetime
                                    ).total_seconds()

                                    remaining_minutes = int(
                                        max(
                                            0,
                                            remaining_seconds
                                        ) / 60
                                    )

                                    warning_message = (
                                        "Production End Time has not been reached yet.\n\n"
                                        "Job Card: "
                                        + str(job_card_name)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Target Quantity: "
                                        + str(target_qty)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Production End Time: "
                                        + str(formatted_end)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Remaining Time: "
                                        + str(remaining_minutes)
                                        + " minutes\n\n"
                                        "Please select the current Job status."
                                    )

                                    outgoing = frappe.get_doc({

                                        "doctype":
                                            "WhatsApp Message",

                                        "type":
                                            "Outgoing",

                                        "account":
                                            "My Whatsapp",

                                        "to":
                                            employee_phone,

                                        "content_type":
                                            "interactive",

                                        "message":
                                            warning_message,

                                        "buttons":
                                            json.dumps([
                                                {
                                                    "type": "button",
                                                    "title": "Completed",
                                                    "id": "job_completed"
                                                },
                                                {
                                                    "type": "button",
                                                    "title": "Pause",
                                                    "id": "job_pause"
                                                }
                                            ]),

                                        "reference_doctype":
                                            "Job Card",

                                        "reference_name":
                                            job_card_name
                                    })

                                    outgoing.insert(
                                        ignore_permissions=True
                                    )

                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 09 - Early completion warning sent\n"
                                        "Remaining Minutes: "+ str(remaining_minutes),
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                    )

                                else:

                                    # =================================================
                                    # PRODUCTION END TIME REACHED
                                    # =================================================

                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 09 - End Time reached\n"
                                        "Proceeding with completion",
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                    )

                                    # -------------------------------------------------
                                    # CLOSE ACTIVE TIME LOG
                                    # -------------------------------------------------

                                    time_logs = frappe.get_all(
                                        "Job Card Time Log",
                                        filters={
                                            "parent": job_card_name,
                                            "parenttype": "Job Card",
                                            "parentfield": "time_logs"
                                        },
                                        fields=[
                                            "name",
                                            "employee",
                                            "from_time",
                                            "to_time"
                                        ],
                                        order_by="idx asc"
                                    )
                                    
                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 10 - Time logs loaded\n"
                                        "Number of logs: " + str(len(time_logs)),
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                        )

                                    for row in time_logs:

                                        if row.from_time and not row.to_time:

                                            from_time = (
                                                frappe.utils.get_datetime(
                                                    row.from_time
                                                )
                                            )

                                            minutes = int(
                                                (
                                                    current_datetime
                                                    - from_time
                                                ).total_seconds() / 60
                                            )

                                            frappe.db.set_value(
                                                "Job Card Time Log",
                                                row.name,
                                                {
                                                    "to_time": current_time,
                                                    "time_in_mins": max(
                                                        0,
                                                        minutes
                                                    ),
                                                    "completed_qty":
                                                        target_qty
                                                }
                                            )

                                            frappe.log_error(
                                                "STEP 10A - Active time log closed\n"
                                                "Time Log: " + str(row.name) + "\n"
                                                "From: " + str(from_time) + "\n"
                                                "To: " + str(current_time) + "\n"
                                                "Minutes: " + str(max(0, minutes)) + "\n"
                                                "Completed Qty: " + str(target_qty),
                                                "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                            )

                                    # -------------------------------------------------
                                    # UPDATE JOB CARD QUANTITIES
                                    # -------------------------------------------------

                                    frappe.db.set_value(
                                        "Job Card",
                                        job_card_name,
                                        {
                                            "pending_qty": 0,
                                            "process_loss_qty": 0,
                                            "total_completed_qty":
                                                target_qty,
                                            "actual_end_date":
                                                current_time,
                                            "is_paused":
                                                0,
                                            "status":
                                                "Completed"
                                        }
                                    )

                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 11 - Job Card fields updated successfully\n"
                                        "Pending Qty: 0\n"
                                        "Process Loss Qty: 0\n"
                                        "Total Completed Qty: "+ str(target_qty)+ "\n"
                                        "Actual End: "+ str(current_time)+ "\n"
                                        "Status: Completed",
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                    )

                                    # -------------------------------------------------
                                    # SUBMIT JOB CARD
                                    # -------------------------------------------------

                                    job_card = frappe.get_doc(
                                        "Job Card",
                                        job_card_name
                                    )

                                    job_card.flags.ignore_permissions = True

                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 12 - Job Card reloaded\n"
                                        "Docstatus before submit: "+ str(job_card.docstatus)+ "\n"
                                        "Status: "+ str(job_card.status),
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                    )
                                    job_card.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 12A - Ignore permissions enabled",
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                        )

            # =================================================
            # STEP 13 - SUBMIT JOB CARD
            # =================================================
            
                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 13 - ABOUT TO SUBMIT JOB CARD\n"
                                        "Job Card: " + str(job_card_name) + "\n"
                                        "Docstatus: " + str(job_card.docstatus) + "\n"
                                        "Status: " + str(job_card.status) + "\n"
                                        "Pending Qty: " + str(job_card.get("pending_qty")) + "\n"
                                        "Process Loss Qty: " + str(job_card.get("process_loss_qty")) + "\n"
                                        "Total Completed Qty: " + str(job_card.get("total_completed_qty")),
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                        )


                                    try:
                                        job_card.submit()
                                    
                                    
                                    
                                    except Exception as submit_error:
                                        frappe.log_error(
                                            "JOB CARD SUBMIT FAILED\n"
                                            "Job Card: "+ str(job_card_name)+ "\n"
                                            "Error: "+ str(submit_error)+ "\n"
                                            "Docstatus: "+ str(job_card.docstatus)+ "\n"
                                            "Status: "+ str(job_card.status)+ "\n"
                                            "Pending Qty: "+ str(job_card.get("pending_qty"))+ "\n"
                                            "Process Loss Qty: "+ str(job_card.get("process_loss_qty"))+ "\n"
                                            "Total Completed Qty: "+ str(job_card.get("total_completed_qty"))+ "\n"
                                            "Expected End: "+ str(job_card.get("expected_end_date"))+ "\n"
                                            "Actual End: "+ str(job_card.get("actual_end_date")),
                                            "JOB CARD SUBMIT FAILED"
                                        )
                                        frappe.throw(
                                                "Job Card submission failed. Check Error Log: JOB CARD SUBMIT FAILED."
                                                )
                                            
                                    frappe.log_error(
                                                "STEP 13A - JOB CARD SUBMIT SUCCESSFUL\n"
                                                "Job Card: "+ str(job_card_name)+ "\n"
                                                "Docstatus: "+ str(job_card.docstatus),
                                                "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                                )





                                    # frappe.log_error(
                                    #     "STEP 13 - Job Card submitted\n"
                                    #     "Job Card: "
                                    #     + str(job_card_name)
                                    #     + "\n"
                                    #     "Docstatus: "
                                    #     + str(job_card.docstatus),
                                    #     "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                    # )

                                    # =================================================
                                    # SEND COMPLETION CONFIRMATION
                                    # =================================================
                                    #
                                    # IMPORTANT:
                                    # completed_message is created BEFORE the
                                    # confirmation try block. Therefore, if the
                                    # WhatsApp send fails, the error handler will
                                    # never fail because of an undefined variable.
                                    # =================================================

                                    completed_message = (
                                        "You completed the Job.\n\n"
                                        "Job Card: "
                                        + str(job_card_name)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Target Quantity: "
                                        + str(target_qty)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Production End Time: "
                                        + str(formatted_end)
                                    )

                                    frappe.log_error(
                                        "STEP 14 - Preparing completion WhatsApp message\n"
                                        "To: "
                                        + str(employee_phone)
                                        + "\n"
                                        "Message: "
                                        + str(completed_message),
                                        "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                    )

                                    # -----------------------------------------
                                    # SEND COMPLETION MESSAGE
                                    # -----------------------------------------

                                    try:

                                        outgoing = frappe.get_doc({

                                            "doctype":
                                                "WhatsApp Message",

                                            "type":
                                                "Outgoing",

                                            "account":
                                                "My Whatsapp",

                                            "to":
                                                employee_phone,

                                            "message_type":
                                                "Manual",

                                            "content_type":
                                                "text",

                                            "message":
                                                completed_message,

                                            "reference_doctype":
                                                "Job Card",

                                            "reference_name":
                                                job_card_name
                                        })

                                        frappe.log_error(
                                            "STEP 14A - WhatsApp Message document created\n"
                                            "To: "
                                            + str(employee_phone),
                                            "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                        )

                                        outgoing.insert(
                                            ignore_permissions=True
                                        )

                                        frappe.log_error(
                                            "STEP 15 - Completion WhatsApp message inserted\n"
                                            "Outgoing Message: "
                                            + str(outgoing.name),
                                            "JOB CARD WHATSAPP DEBUG"
                                        )

                                    except Exception as e:

                                        # -------------------------------------
                                        # ONLY CATCH WHATSAPP SEND ERROR
                                        # -------------------------------------

                                        frappe.log_error(
                                            "COMPLETION WHATSAPP SEND ERROR\n"
                                            "Job Card: "
                                            + str(job_card_name)
                                            + "\n"
                                            "To: "
                                            + str(employee_phone)
                                            + "\n"
                                            "Error: "
                                            + str(e)
                                            + "\n"
                                            "Message: "
                                            + str(completed_message),
                                            "JOB CARD WHATSAPP ERROR"
                                        )

                            except Exception as e:

                                # -----------------------------------------
                                # COMPLETION WORKFLOW ERROR
                                # -----------------------------------------

                                frappe.log_error(
                                    "COMPLETION WORKFLOW ERROR\n"
                                    "Job Card: "
                                    + str(job_card_name)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "To: "
                                    + str(employee_phone)
                                    + "\n"
                                    "Error: "
                                    + str(e),
                                    "JOB CARD WHATSAPP ERROR"
                                )


            except Exception as e:

                frappe.log_error(
                    "GENERAL WORKFLOW ERROR\n"
                    "Job Card: "
                    + str(job_card_name)
                    + "\n"
                    "Error: "
                    + str(e),
                    "JOB CARD WHATSAPP ERROR"
                )

name: Job Card Whatsapp Flow
script:
# ============================================================
# JOB CARD WHATSAPP INITIAL MESSAGE
# Event: After Save
# ============================================================

try:

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Only send for an unsaved/unsubmitted Job Card
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    if doc.docstatus == 0:

        employees = doc.get("employee") or []

        if employees:

            employee_id = employees[0].get("employee")

            if employee_id:

                mobile = frappe.db.get_value(
                    "Employee",
                    employee_id,
                    "cell_number"
                )

                expected_end = doc.get("expected_end_date")

                if mobile and expected_end:

                    phone = "".join(
                        c for c in str(mobile)
                        if c.isdigit()
                    )

                    # ------------------------------------------------
                    # IMPORTANT:
                    # Check whether the INITIAL WhatsApp message
                    # for this Job Card was already sent.
                    #
                    # We do NOT check for all WhatsApp messages,
                    # because Pause/Resume messages also reference
                    # the same Job Card.
                    # ------------------------------------------------
                    existing_initial_message = frappe.get_all(
                        "WhatsApp Message",
                        filters=[
                            ["type", "=", "Outgoing"],
                            ["reference_doctype", "=", "Job Card"],
                            ["reference_name", "=", doc.name],
                            ["content_type", "=", "interactive"],
                            ["message", "like", "Production Job Card%"]
                        ],
                        fields=["name"],
                        limit=1
                    )

                    # ------------------------------------------------
                    # Send ONLY if the initial message does not exist
                    # ------------------------------------------------
                    if not existing_initial_message:

                        end_time_text = frappe.utils.format_datetime(
                            expected_end,
                            "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss"
                        )

                        initial_message = (
                            "Production Job Card\n\n"
                            "Job Card: " + str(doc.name) + "\n"
                            "Target Quantity: " + str(doc.for_quantity) + "\n"
                            "Production End Time: " + end_time_text + "\n\n"
                            "Please select the Job status."
                        )

                        message = frappe.get_doc({
                            "doctype": "WhatsApp Message",
                            "type": "Outgoing",
                            "account": "My Whatsapp",
                            "to": phone,
                            "message_type": "Manual",
                            "content_type": "interactive",
                            "message": initial_message,
                            "buttons": json.dumps([
                                {
                                    "type": "button",
                                    "title": "Completed",
                                    "id": "job_completed"
                                },
                                {
                                    "type": "button",
                                    "title": "Pause",
                                    "id": "job_pause"
                                }
                            ]),
                            "reference_doctype": "Job Card",
                            "reference_name": doc.name
                        })

                        message.insert(
                            ignore_permissions=True
                        )

except Exception as e:

    frappe.log_error(
        "Job Card: " + str(doc.name) + "\n"
        "Error: " + str(e),
        "JOB CARD INITIAL WHATSAPP ERROR"
    )
